company.name: Onshore
company.shortDescription: Onshore provides AI-powered software that automates corporate R&D tax credit and incentive analysis and reporting for businesses.
company.description:
Onshore is an AI-powered tax platform that pairs intelligent automation with human tax expertise to help businesses unlock, optimize, and defend complex incentives like the R&D Tax Credit, 179D Deduction, and Cost Segregation studies.

Onshore cuts study timelines from 270 days to just 28, helping companies file in weeks, at 30–50% lower cost, while uncovering up to 15% more eligible credits. 

Founded in 2020 and based in New York, Onshore serves businesses across industries and is trusted by leading accounting firms, SMBs, and Fortune 1000 enterprises.
